lines.text: Sanballat ridiculed the Jews before the army of Samaria, and Tobiah the Ammonite said a fox would break their wall.
The builders joined the wall up to half its height, and Sanballat, Tobiah, and their allies conspired to fight against Jerusalem.
After Jews nearby warned seven times of attack, Nehemiah stationed families with swords, spears, and bows behind the lowest sections of the wall.
Nehemiah told the people to remember the Lord and fight for their families, and each builder worked with a sword at his side.
Nehemiah told every man and his servant to spend the night inside Jericho, so they could guard by night and work by day.
